description.narrative: The resurgence of the M23 rebel group in North and South Kivu has escalated conflict, leading to an acute humanitarian crisis with mass displacement with at least 700.000 people internally displaced within north and south Kivu. Humanitarian and protection needs increased considerably.
To save lives and alleviate suffering of displaced people in Goma through provision of life-saving food and non-food items

Total beneficiaries: 8100 People. Women: Children: Men: Elderly: project aims to reach 1350 households (approximately 8,100 people) Most vulnerable affected households in Goma ((targeted neighbourhoods will include Keshero, Mikeno/Birere, Mapendo and Katindo), affected by the current conflict and forceful displacement. Beneficiary selection will be done with the support of the community leaders, church leaders and other responders on the ground. The final list of selected beneficiaries/locations for support will be verified by CAFOD, Caritas Goma, local leaders and other stakeholders and representatives of the affected population at community meetings, to enhance transparency and promote harmony within the community.

title.narrative: FSC-R2: Number of people enabled to meet their basic food needs (non-cash)

description.narrative: Basic food needs: assistance, combined with beneficiaries' own resources, to international standard of 2100 kcal per person per day for the period of the action. Any kind of transfer modality (in-kind, voucher, cash) and combination thereof with objective to ensure immediate access to the necessary food commodities. This may include supplementary foods provided alongside general distribution for vulnerable people.

title.narrative: SHL-R4: Number of people provided with non-food items (other than hygiene/dignity kits)

description.narrative: Distribution of Non-Food Items. All household materials excluding those that fall under hygiene/dignity kits or direct shelter items. Also excludes unrestricted cash, which is to be put under indicator CSH-I1 or CSH-I2. However, if cash is provided for the purpose of buying household items, it should be put under this indicator (i.e. restricted cash).
